text: Let me guess. You forgot your wife’s birthday, and she got angry.
No. Actually, I was carrying some boxes down the stairs at home . . .
No, no! I was walking down the stairs at home when I tripped over our dog and fell and broke my arm and injured my shoulder.
Boy, how’s the dog? You look really sore, too.
Well, I am, but I am going to physical therapy three twice a week, and they’re trying to teach me some exercises to increase my strength.
Good. So, how long are your appointments?
Actually, it is across the street from my office, so it’s really convenient.
Yeah, and it should help me get back to where I was before the accident, and I really want to play tennis again.
Well, maybe now, at least I have a chance to beat you.
